title: Inu-Tan and Tan-Tan Totem
description:
just a silly resource pack that replaces totem of undying with a "wha" Inu-Tan and Tan-Tan plush
this resource pack includes:
•custom model
•custom texture
•custom name
•custom subtitle text
•custom sound effect
body:
this resource pack brings to life a InuTan plush with TanTan on top of her head :P you can modify and use models files however you want by using blockbench

it will replace totem of undying and all releated to it with tanger themed ones!
> rename your totem to 'inutan' to turn it into plush

characters by Tanger
